Farm Pass is an activity which gives players rewards by performing in-game actions. It is held in baby chick house, which is built next to Derby.

Farm Pass is unlocked at experience level 11. It was added to the game at 24 Nov 2020.

Duration

Farm Pass lasts 1 month, from 8am UTC on the first day of the month to 7:59am UTC on the first day of the following month.

Full Farm Pass

Purchasing Full Farm Pass costs $4.99 USD (Free in farm pass trial season). It gives players access to upper part of rewards on farm pass road when they get certain points. Rewards include perks, which only last until the season ends. Full farm pass doesn't last across seasons, so players have choice to purchase in different seasons, depend on rewards quality.

In January 2024, two extension of the original Farm Pass (Beta version) have been released. Firstly, Party Pass costs $4.99 USD. It gives players additional perks, super boosters, and another seasonal decoration. The perks are storage boosters for your silo and barn. Secondly, Festival Pass costs $3.99 USD. It gives players better grade of super boosters. Players need to get the Farm Pass before Party Pass, and you have to get Party Pass before going for the Festival Pass

You get the best value for your money by purchasing Full Farm Pass at the beginning of the event because you will have the Perks for the longest period of time. Also, You can get cheaper three Pass by purchasing all at once.

Goals

Players are awarded with Pass Points when they complete Goals. There are 2 types of Goals: Daily goals and season goals.

Daily Goals are tasks that lasts for a day and award 3 Pass Points each. Since season 4, tasks released on day 8 gives 3 points, those on day 15 gives 4 points, those on day 22 gives 5 points. 3 new daily tasks are added every day at 08:00 UTC and those from yesterday are expired, so players should play the game every day to get more rewards. Examples are:

  • Complete 1 Truck order
  • Fill 2 production slots in a specified production building
  • Plant 30 specified crop
  • Feed 10 farm animals
  • Plant 2 Fruit Trees / Bushes
  • Fill 3 Boat Crates

Season Goals are more difficult tasks that last until the end of the Farm Pass and award 50 points each in season 1-3. Since season 4, tasks released on day 1 gives 50 points, those on day 8 gives 60 points, those on day 15 gives 75 points, those on day 22 gives 85 points. 3 tasks are added every 7 days at 12:30 UTC. You also can spend 10 diamonds to unlock more task to faster farm point collection. Examples are:

  • Collect 30 fruits from any trees / bushes
  • Collect 9 fish fillet using fishing / mystery net
  • Complete 20 truck orders
  • Fill 30 boat crates
  • Complete and send off 5 boats
  • Harvest 210 crops
  • Feed 50 animals
  • Put 100 goods for sale in your roadside shop
  • Collect 15 products in a specified production building
  • Sell goods to 5 farm visitors

To get all rewards in Original Farm Pass, players need to collect 600 farm points. For taking all rewards in Party Pass and Festival Pass, player need to reach at 900 points and 1150 points respectively.

Perks

Perks are obtained when players complete Goals and earn Pass Points. There are currently 12 types of perks. One perk is unlocked for all players when they get points, the other 11 can only be unlocked by Full Farm Pass players. All perks expire at the end of a farm pass season so players can either buy full farm pass again in the next season or only enjoy one unlocked perk.

Image Perk Effect
Extra Production Slot Get 2 extra production slots for a production building! Choose between 3 production buildings! Players receive one set of choice below.
Bakery, Dairy or Ice Cream Maker
Sugar Mill, Cake Oven or Popcorn Pot
Reactivate Derby Task Once per Derby, you can reactivate an expired task. Does not use up a task from your total!
Extra Truck Help You can ask for help on one additional truck order every day.
Extra Boat Help You can ask for help on one additional boat crate every day.
Extra Town Visitor Help You can ask for help for one additional town visitor order every day.
Extra Neighborhood Requests Place two neighborhood requests at a time.
Free Valley Fuel Spins Get one extra free Valley Fuel Spin every day.
Free Wheel of Fortune Spins Get one Free spin in the Wheel of Fortune, every day until the season ends! Free spin given from jackpot doesn't count for farm pass free spin.
Gift Diamonds Gift boxes are sent in neighborhood chat. Each neighbor receives 5 diamonds when they tap the gift box in chat. Gift box disappears after 5 neighbors collected their gift, but it stays a the top of chat rather than disappear after a lot of messages if less than 5 players collected the gift.
Additional Booster Slot Have two active boosts slots until the Pass season ends!
Extra Silo Capacity Get 50 more spots to Silo capacity. Lasts until the farm Pass season ends.
Extra Barn Capacity Get 50 more spots to Barn capacity. Lasts until the farm Pass season ends.

Seasons

Trial season: Nov 24 to 27, 2020

  • The Farm Pass Trial Season is a 3-day trial season to ensure that everything runs smoothly for the Farm Pass Season 1. The Full Farm Pass is available to all players for free. The final reward is Pink Birthday Hat.

Season 1: Dec 1, 2020 to Jan 1, 2021

  • Free farm pass perk: Free Wheel of Fortune Spins
  • New exclusive hat for farm animals: A Green Beanie

Season 2: Jan 2 to Feb 1, 2021

  • Free farm pass perk: Boat help
  • New exclusive hat for farm animals: Pink Cowboy Hat

Season 3: Feb 2 to Mar 1, 2021

  • Free farm pass perk: Extra Production Slot! (Choose between Sugar Mill, Cake Oven or Popcorn Pot)
  • New exclusive hat for farm animals: Red Emperor Hat

Season 4: Mar 2 to Apr 1, 2021

  • Free Farm Pass perk: Extra Truck Help!
  • New exclusive hat: Brown Alpine Hat for your animals to wear!
  • New exclusive decoration: Pig Sign!
  • Seasonal goals give different points, as stated above.

Season 5: Apr 2 to May 1, 2021

  • Free Farm Pass perk: Extra Valley Spin!
  • New exclusive hat: Bunny Ears for your animals to wear!
  • Special Free Decoration: Bunny Gnome!
  • Special Decoration: Jumping Bunny!

Season 6: May 2 to June 1, 2021

  • Free Farm Pass perk: Extra Neighborhood Requests!
  • New exclusive hat: Propeller Cap for your animals to wear!
  • Special Free Decoration: Pink Trumpet tree!
  • Special Decoration #1: Beach Hut!
  • Special Decoration #2: Bee Flower!

Season 7: June 1 to June 30, 2021

  • New Exclusive Hat: Birthday Party Hat!
  • Special Decoration #1: Disco Cake!
  • Special Decoration #2: Chick Balloon!
  • Special Decoration #3: Birthday Tent!
  • Free Decoration: Sheep Balloon!
  • Free Farm Pass Perk: Extra Town Help!

Season 8: July 1 to July 31, 2021

  • New exclusive hat: Sand Cowboy Hat for your animals to wear!
  • Special Decoration #1: Hammock!
  • Special Decoration #2: Fitting Room!
  • Free Farm Pass perk: Extra Boat Help!
  • Free Decoration: Fish Fence!

Season 9: August 1 to August 31, 2021

  • New exclusive hat: Alpine Green Hat!
  • Special Decoration #1: Shipwreck!
  • Special Decoration #2: Potted Succulents!
  • Free Farm Pass perk: Production Building Boost!
  • Free Decoration: Wavy Bush!

Season 10: September 1 to September 30, 2021

  • New exclusive hat: Pompom Hat!
  • Special Decoration #1: Pumpkin Rocking Chair!
  • Special Decoration #2: Pumpkin Carving Table!
  • Special Decoration #3: Treehouse!
  • Free Decoration: Pinecones!
  • Free Farm Pass perk: Extra Boat Help!

Season 11: October 1 to October 31, 2021

  • New exclusive hat: Brown Cowboy Hat!
  • Special Decoration #1: Halloween Alter!
  • Special Decoration #2: Pumpkin Chicks!
  • Free Decoration: Halloween Cauldron!
  • Free Farm Pass perk: Extra Valley Spin!

Season 12: November 1 to November 30, 2021

  • New exclusive hat: Red Beanie
  • Special Decoration #1: Cozy Fireplace
  • Special Decoration #2: Craved Chick
  • Free Decoration: Music Box
  • Free Farm Pass perk: Building Boost

Season 13: December 1 to December 31, 2021

  • New exclusive hat: Red Elf Hat
  • Special Decoration #1: Jolly Clothes
  • Special Decoration #2: Jolly Corner
  • Special Decoration #3: Candy Pool
  • Free Decoration: Winter Sock
  • Free Farm Pass perk: Extra Town Help

Season 14: January 1 to January 31, 2022

  • New exclusive hat: Emperor Blue
  • Special Decoration #1: Dragon Bell
  • Special Decoration #2: Pavilion
  • Special Decoration #3: Snowchicks
  • Free Decoration: Little Tiger
  • Free Farm Pass perk: Extra Truck Help

Season 15: February 1 to February 28, 2022

  • New exclusive hat: Love Cap
  • Special Decoration #1: Heart Bench
  • Special Decoration #2: Flamingos
  • Special Decoration #3: Love Birds
  • Free Decoration: Rose Tree
  • Free Farm Pass perk: Extra Neighborhood Request

Season 16: March 1 to March 31, 2022

  • New exclusive hat: Top Green Hat
  • Special Decoration #1: Haybale Bench
  • Special Decoration #2: Chicken Haystack
  • Special Decoration #3: Bookworms
  • Free Decoration: Crocus Flowers
  • Free Farm Pass perk: Extra Building Slots

Season 17: April 1 to April 30, 2022

  • New exclusive hat: Bowler Umbrella
  • Special Decoration #1: Butterfly Balloons
  • Special Decoration #2: Baby Chicken Pool
  • Special Decoration #3: Chicken Feet Shaped Bush
  • Free Decoration #1: Flower Path
  • Free Decoration #2: Gnome Painter
  • Free Farm Pass perk: Extra Building Slots

Season 18: May 1 to May 31, 2022

  • New exclusive hat: Boater Pompom
  • Special Decoration #1: Rustic Birdhouse
  • Special Decoration #2: Paper Boat Puddle
  • Free Decoration #1: Flower Log Path
  • Free Decoration #2: Rustic Hose
  • Free Farm Pass perk: Extra Town Help

Season 19: June 1 to June 30, 2022

  • New exclusive hat: Twisted Balloon Chicken Hat
  • Free exclusive hat: Twisted Balloon Stars Hat
  • Special Decoration #1: Hot Air Balloon
  • Special Decoration #2: Mid-Summer Festival Maypole
  • Free Decoration: 10th Birthday Flag Fence
  • Free Farm Pass perk: Extra Town Help

Additional Information

  • The rewards in Farm Pass Road are different for each player. If some rewards or perks are not available due to players' low level, they will get coins, xp or Supplies instead.
  • Boosters are sometimes offered as rewards in farm pass.
  • More coins and more xp boosters don't apply when claiming farm pass rewards.
